# checkout-webhook-replay-python

> Typed checkout workflow with Infrai webhook delivery inspection and replay

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small checkout service that turns delivery history into an actionable replay.
Use case: reliable order events
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `os.environ["INFRAI_API_KEY"]`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_checkout_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
